findings.evidence: 오늘 뭐/언제 해요? are both natural questions with an omitted activity.
한국어 단어를 어떻게/언제/어디(서) 외워요? all ask natural follow-ups; the location particle is commonly omitted in speech.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 어떻게 against 어디 and 언제.

findings.evidence: 회사까지 얼마나/왜 걸려요? are both natural duration/reason questions.
무슨/어느 음악을 좋아해요? are both natural, asking kind versus selection.
어느/무슨 카페에서 만날까요? are both natural.
질문/이유가 있으면 지금 물어보세요 are both natural.
왜 대답/질문/이유가 없어요? are all natural.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 대답 against 질문 and 이유.

findings.evidence: 그 이유/질문/대답이 뭐예요? are all natural.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 이유 against 질문 and 대답.

findings.evidence: 좋은 방법/질문/대답이 있어요? are all natural.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 방법 against 질문 and 대답.
